CFML Language Reference: Functions

Day

Returns the day-of-the-month number of a date/time value.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

Day(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

A number from 1 to 31.

Usage

Same as DatePart("d", date). Use DayOfWeek for the weekday and DayOfYear for the day within the year.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Date</TH><TH>Day()</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>"October 22, 1999"</TD><TD>#Day("October 22, 1999")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>"2/29/2000"</TD><TD>#Day("2/29/2000")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Today</TD><TD>#Day(Now())#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Month, Year, DayOfWeek, DayOfYear, DatePart
